lines.en: : What the heck is this?! Was our class always this adorable?!
: The new uniforms came in this morning. Well...all except one.
: APPARENTLY, I’m a little too old to wear a school uniform! And that it isn’t appropriate for working adults to wear them! Which totally isn’t insulting at all!
: I mean, it’s not like I’ve wanted to go to school with uniforms for my entire life or anything. And it’s not like you guys are only a little younger than me or anything!
: AND IT’S NOT LIKE I ACTUALLY CARE OR ANYTHING!
: You doing okay over there?
: Just peachy, Senpai. Just peachy.

Just as Imani said, it looks like all of the girls have changed into their new uniforms and that we no longer have roughly half the class decked out in one that I never thought was flattering to begin with.
Also, it looks like all of them are still here with the exception of the one girl who’s never here to begin with.
But hey, if Yumi is gone, at least my days will be easier and filled with less profanity.
: Uhh...did something happen to Miku? She looks unusually...not loud today.
: Ahh...yeah.
: The school decided to do away with all of the intramural sports teams since none of them had anybody to play against and were running low on members anyway.
: The soccer team just happened to be among the casualties. She’s looked pretty down ever since I came in this morning.
: Thankfully, she’s got her friends with her to cheer her up and whatnot.
: Besides, we’ve got plenty of other sports clubs still going strong! Or...ones that are on the cusp of going strong but...haven’t actually started yet.
: What I’m trying to say is that there’s no shortage of excuses for her to be active. But yeah, kinda sucks when something you love gets taken away.
: But anyway! I guess I’m gonna do the thing now since we’re already like two hours behind thanks to all of the fluids you had to clean off of each other.
: What? Ew. Why would you even say something like that? Aren’t you supposed to be the good teacher?
: No way! I’m the young and quirky one who you’re all supposed to look up to because I am both an intellectual and super cool.
: Also, I think I see a little love juice stuck in your hair, so I’m just gonna-
: Touch me and I will kill you.
: Jeeeez. Somebody needs a post-coitus cigarette.
: Imani, do the announcement thing.
: Fine, fine! Just let me look at my notes one more time.
: Where exactly did we get her again?
: Ghana.
: I didn’t mean literally. I mean how is a borderline predator as a teacher any better than an actual predator?
: Technically, she’s a student teacher.
: Yeah. Sensei is teaching her how to become a full predator and it falls on you and me to serve as examples to help her learn.
: Please tell me this isn’t just how you’re going to be now.
: But Maya, all that’s really changed about me is that I know we’re rivals now. And I think that’s something we can bond over.
: We are rivals over nothing and anything you thought you heard was simply apocalypse-induced delirium.
: That’s fine. I’ll just have to be the only test subject for Imani’s predatorial lessons.
: I sure hope my body can handle it.
: Oh, I’m sure it can.
: Hey! What’s the big deal?! You three show up an hour late in casual clothes and don’t even ask me if I want to join in?!
: I swear, if you guys are having some special sort of Sensei Love Squad meeting without the president of the Sensei Love Squad, I will end all three of you!
: Even me?
: Mhm! Ayane left her notes at her house the other night and I read her plans for the next science fair about how to reanimate dead bodies.
: Hey! Stop going through my things! Those plans were for Sana and me only!
: Seriously, though. What’s going on here? Why are you guys dressed like that? And why are you showing up so late?
: It was weird enough that you made me walk to school by myself, but now I have to figure out why you’re keeping secrets from me and-
: Wait!
: You three are planning a surprise party for me, aren’t you?!
: Surprise.
: Is it...really August already? I feel like our Christmas party wasn’t even that long ago.
: Aww! You guys! You didn’t have to go and do something like that for me. You know I’m happy just being with you.
: But...if you are going to throw a party for me, I’m not opposed. I’d just like some say in the decorations. Oh, and I’ll make the cake.
: You’re going to make the cake for your own surprise party?
: Well, yeah. I don’t trust anyone else and I assume Sensei is going to eat it, so...
: Okay, well...I’m going to go sit down and...try and sort out my thoughts for the...uhh...surprise party. But the three of you are free to continue standing around and...being weird.
: Wait, before you sit down, are we still going to karaoke with Uta after class? Because Io apparently bailed on her and it makes me feel weird how she’s always going there to sing all by herself.
: Uhhhhhhh...yes?...
: Why do you sound so unsure? Do you hate Uta now? Or...wait! Do you hate me?
: Uhhhhhhh...
: Ami, this is probably going to sound like a weird question, but...
: Does Despacito still exist in this timeline?
: Seriously? That is what you’re concerned about?
: I need to know.
: Why...
: Why wouldn’t Despacito exist anymore?
: Thank you, Ami. That is all I needed to hear.
: Attention, girls who are only slightly younger than I am and still allowed to wear school uniforms without being judged!
: Miss Imai, I hardly think that’s an appropriate way to start this announcement.
: Hey! Fuck you!
: Wha-
: God I love her so much.
: Anyway! What I was about to say is that the deadline for the Great Migration, also known as the Wonky Club Hop and the After School Switcharoo is tomorrow!
: This means that everybody-
: And I mean everybody! I’m looking at you, Sana!
: W-What?! What did I do?!
: Everybody has to choose a club to join! No more of that “Going Home Club” BS.
: Do I make myself clear, Sana?!
: Umm...uhh!
: Love the new get-up, by the way. You’re cute as hell, girl.
: I...umm...thank you?
: Imani! What do you think of my new uniform? How do I look?
: Like a slut pretending to not be a slut!
: Ah-
: Do you still love her now, Kirin?
: I think I love her even more...
: Anyway! If anybody has any questions or needs a full list of what clubs there are to choose from, come talk to me!
: Until then, class dismissed! Just...not really. Since there are still, like...five hours left of the school day.
: Guhhhhhhhhhh~
: Kirin, can you please keep your hormones in check for five minutes and focus on the task at hand?
: Right! Yeah! Sorry!
: Miku, you’re going to be fine without the soccer team. You know that, right? There are tons of other clubs you’d be great at.
: And, even on the off chance you wind up sucking at them for some reason, I’m sure there’s some sort of...recreational soccer league you can join around here, right?
: It ain’t the same, Kirin. The team is...
: The team is...
: They’re the only family I’ve got!
: Seein’ them every weekend’s what keeps me goin’! And now I can’t even do that because the friggin’ school thinks it’s pointless if we ain’t got anybody to play against?!
: That ain’t what it’s about! That ain’t ever been what’s it about!
: They’re not gone, Miku...I’m still here. Karin’s still here. We’re just...going our separate ways now.
: I don’t wanna go separate ways...I wanna stay together with everybody. I ain’t ready to leave yet!

: Well...what if you come join the archery club? I know it’s not really as active as you’d probably like, but...I mean, I was never great at soccer anyway. And that’s where I plan on going, so at least you’d have me.
: There’s always the swim club as well, Miku. And it’s got an Olympic size pool, so you’d be able to get as much energy out as you want.
: I’m sorry you guys feel like you’ve gotta cheer me up. I’ve known about this for weeks, so the fact that I’m cryin’ about it now must seem pretty stupid, huh?
: Not at all. Soccer’s always been a huge part of your life.
: Yeah! But that doesn’t mean there aren’t other parts that won’t be enjoyable!
: Like hey, you might love archery! You won’t know until you try!
: I do think the swim club would make more sense, though. Especially for someone like Miku who’s more accustomed to active sports.
: Yeah, but it’s not like archery isn’t active. Have you ever tried using a longbow? That shit’s exhausting, prez.
: I didn’t say it wasn’t. But I do think that maybe we should be taking Miku’s best interests into consideration and weighing which options would most closely correlate to what she’s used to.
: I did that, Makoto. I’m sure I don’t have to remind you of how long Miku and I have been on a team together, do I?
: Do you actually think that compares to how long I’ve been with Miku for? Because-
: If you guys are just gonna fight over me, go back to yer own desks. I’ll join whichever club I feel like joinin’.
: But right now, I just...kinda wanna be left alone.
: Great, now look what you’ve done, Makoto.
: Me? You can’t be serious. I’m the one who was trying to stop you just now.
: Hah...
: Or just keep fightin’...
: That’s fine too...
: Dude! I can’t believe I’m actually, like...stoked for a school-related thing. But the more I think about it, the more into it I’m getting.
: I’m stoked for you, Otoha! Joining the light music club means you’ll get to play pretty much whenever you want!
: Which means that I will be able to hear you play whenever I want! Which means that both of our schedules have gotten exponentially better out of virtually nowhere!
: Yeah. And between this and your hot new haircut, it seems like my days have been getting a lot better in a bunch of ways, lately.
: Oh, this? I mean...this is just hair. Hair that...grows out of my head. Which is now shorter. Which you apparently like.
: It’s good to see you two are still doing well.
: Is...Is Rin...broken?...
: Yeah...things were a little rocky for a bit after the Christmas party, but-
: OTOHA OKAKURA!
: Um...N...Noriko...Nakayama?
: It’s Nakayarakawayama now. I changed my name.
: Can you change it back?
: No.
: Oh. Okay then. You do you.
: You’re joining, right? The light music club?
: Oh man. Does this mean what I think it means?
: Should we start booking our reunion tour now? Or later?
: THE BAND IS GETTING BACK TOGETHER, BITCHES!
: You two were...in a band together?...
: Kind of, yeah. It’s not like we ever really played any shows or anything. My parents were always weird about that.
: But it’ll be a hell of a lot easier to hide now that I don’t live at home anymore. Plus, Noriko’s like, a ridiculous fucking bassist.
: What can I say? I’m an expert when it comes to fingering.
: Please don’t say things like that around my girlfriend.
: Speaking of which! You’re gonna join too, right?! Having another guitarist would mean that all we’re missing is a drummer and, like...maybe someone on keys if we want to go full K-On.
: Me? Uhh...
: Y...Yeah! Totally! I’d love to join you guys if Otoha is okay with it!
: Are you kidding? Why wouldn’t I be okay with that? I’d love to be in the same club as you.
: Wait, Rin...what about the manga club?
: ...Fuck.
: Does this mean you’re planning on leaving?
: Well...
: I’m not going to get offended if you want to stay in manga club, Rin. I just think it would be cool to be in the same club together.
: No, I...I really want to join the light music club with you guys! I’ve always wanted to be in something like that and...and I want to spend more time with you!
: It’s just...I don’t...really know what to do.
: Well...whatever you do decide to do...know that I won’t take it personally.
: But if you are planning on leaving the manga club...you should at least talk to Molly about it.
: It wouldn’t be right to just...abandon her without saying anything.
: Yeah...I know...just...
: Ugh...this would be so much easier if we were allowed to be in two clubs at once.
: What about you, Nodoka? You’ve been awfully silent over there.
: Any idea what club you’re joining yet?
: Heh heh heh...
: As if there was ever a choice to begin with...
: Skintight...spandex...school swimsuits...
: Changing and showering together...
: Touching each other’s bodies...
: I...don’t think that’s part of the-
: The medley of assorted shampoos blending together into the single purest, most mouth-watering aroma a person could ask for...
: Not to mention the probability of wardrobe malfunctions is exponentially higher in the swim club than any other club this school has to offer...
: Hearing all of that, do you truly think there could be any other place for me?
: Nope. That’s pretty much you, alright.
: Well...at least you’re honest.
: Is Nodoka always this...um...
: Whatever you’re going to ask, the answer is yes.
: Sometimes, I think Nodoka might like girls even more than you do, Rin.
: Rin?
: I think...um...
: Maybe I want to...join the swim club as well...
